sentences.en: Temper tantrums are unpleasant and disruptive behaviours or emotional outbursts.
sentences.zh: 情绪发泄是不愉快且会扰乱课堂秩序的行为或情感爆发。

sentences.en: Working shifts can be extremely disruptive to family life.
sentences.zh: 轮班工作会对家庭生活造成极大的干扰。

sentences.en: Arguments can be disruptive at work.
sentences.zh: 争吵会在工作中产生破坏性影响。

senses.zh: 破坏性的，扰乱性的；引起混乱的；颠覆性的，创新性的
